capabilities: Run a local MCP server inside Obsidian bound to 127.0.0.1 with token authentication
Connect Claude Desktop with one click or Claude Code with one command
Expose read tools for listing folders, reading notes, searching text and tags, and backlinks
Expose write tools (create, append, replace, move, trash, edit frontmatter) behind an allow-writing toggle
Look up and verify Brazilian court súmula citations against an embedded official-text database
disambiguation: Despite the legal branding and the built-in Brazilian súmula database, it serves any vault, not only legal work.
extras: Also ships projurista-sumulas.mjs, a standalone Node.js script with the three súmula tools for use without Obsidian; no telemetry, ads, payment, or account; main.js is about 1.6 MB because the súmula database is embedded.
motivation: The author built it for people using artificial intelligence applied to law, though it works for any vault.
problem: AI assistants cannot see an Obsidian vault, and setting up an MCP connection normally requires installing Node.js, certificates, and hand-editing Claude's config JSON.

summary: Local MCP server that connects Claude Desktop, Claude Code and other MCP clients to the vault for reading, searching and editing notes.
